title: Experimental data and control code for composite ADRC of a cable-coupled single-rod hydraulic cylinder
version: V3, package dated 2026-11-12, repository updated 2026-11-18; DOI record spans versions
rights: CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/, per DataCite and V3 internal metadata. New summaries acknowledge the dataset creator.
evidence_level: Complete V3 archive downloaded independently from two public endpoints, including all 43 original 14-column records, indexed inclusion/exclusion, C# implementation and supplementary material. All 43 file SHA-256 values verified against source_index_normalized.csv.

search_log.screening: File tree checked across V1, V2 and V3; pinned the latest single V3 archive. Older extracted file listings or converted spreadsheet previews are not used for results.

observations: 43 raw physical 20-kg cable-coupled cylinder logs, 563,385 rows, median logging interval 0.002 s. 33 primary runs, 5 screening failures, 4 separate failure runs and 1 separate boundary run.

Threshold |u_V| >= 6.49 V compared row by row with stored sat. 40 of 43 records disagree at least once. Counts: 0 both true, 7,592 near-rail without flag and 6,395 flagged with intermediate voltage. C# ADRCWireController.cs lines 979–989 flags either inner amplitude or per-step rate constraint. MergedWireController.cs lines 249–275 propagates the flag, applies optional dead-zone compensation and outer limits.
limits: Voltage is a logged software output; no row-wise unsaturated demand, physical coil or spool measurement. The four-cell table compares distinct observables and does not classify one as hardware ground truth or infer a cause for each discrepancy.

Positions are measured, but tension is an internal estimate. The 2 ms logged grid (t_s constructed from cycle count in archived C#) does not establish PID runtime period, wall-clock jitter or timing of each physical update. Some retained files wrap or repeat cycles. Different reference shaping and a single rig preclude generic controller rankings.
The deposit metadata describes an associated manuscript as submitted; this release is cited as data.
reproduce: Save the V3 ZIP and run python derive_cable.py CEP_ADRC_evidence_v3_2026-11-12.zip OUT (NumPy/pandas). Outputs: cable-voltage-flags-by-run.csv and cable-screening-groups.csv, including the ten separately retained cases.
